_comment: THE 132 EUROPEAN PLANTS OF THE GLOBAL IRON AND STEEL TRACKER, June 2026 (V1), worked one at a time.
KEYED BY GEM'S OWN `GEM plant ID`, which is the benchmark's own identifier.
GEM'S FORWARD STATUS IS RECORDED ON EVERY ENTRY AS A CLAIM WITH ITS VINTAGE, and never as a
class. The unit tables say what GEM knows, not what exists: a plant GEM shows with no
announced or construction unit may have an owner-announced DRI, EAF or hydrogen-ready furnace
GEM has not recorded. The 37 plants with a forward unit are where the perimeter is likely to
bite; THE 95 WITHOUT ONE ARE WHERE THE CENSUS EARNS ITS NAME.
EVERY ENTRY RECORDS WHICH LIST IT CAME FROM. GEM's floor is 0.5 mtpa, stated on its own About
tab; LeadIT sets no capacity floor. An entry on one list and not the other is a fact about the
lists, and the coverage and drift claims name the source list in every case.

says: GEM records DRI announced, EAF announced, EAF announced, EAF announced at this plant.
gem_claim.note: A BENCHMARK CLAIM, NOT A CLASS. GEM's unit tables say what GEM knows as of its June 2026 (V1) vintage. A plant it shows with no forward unit may still have an owner-announced DRI, EAF or hydrogen-ready furnace that GEM has not recorded, and the only way to find out is to read the owner. Every one of the 132 is searched before it is classed.
